onboarding.welcomeBody: Community edition: offline capture, local transcription, and image compress. Pro unlocks batch, queue, editor, subtitles, and mobile bridge.
onboarding.downloadBody: Open Media Capture → paste a public link → Analyze → Save. Single-link capture is unlimited; change the save folder in Settings anytime.
onboarding.clipboardBody: Optionally detect video page links you copy for a quick capture. Off by default — turn on only if you want it. Change anytime in Settings.
onboarding.enginesBody: Missing tools: {{list}}. Open Settings → Core engines to fix, or reinstall the app.
onboarding.doneBody: Start with a single download. Upgrade to Pro when you need batch, enhance, subtitles, or mobile bridge.
